sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Gold-Tone Glass Bangles Set of 12 with Crystal Dotted Work
sourceNotes.rawContent:
Elevate your ethnic and festive look with this exquisite gold-tone glass bangles set, crafted to bring timeless elegance and royal charm to your jewelry collection. This set includes 12 finely designed glass bangles, each adorned with delicate crystal-style dotted embellishments that shimmer beautifully under light, giving a luxurious and graceful finish.
The rich golden hue combined with sparkling detailing makes these bangles an ideal choice for weddings, bridal wear, festivals, pooja ceremonies, receptions, and special celebrations. Made from premium-quality glass, the bangles feature a smooth, glossy finish that enhances their shine while ensuring a comfortable fit when worn together as a full set.
Whether paired with a traditional saree, lehenga, or an elegant ethnic suit, this gold bangle set adds a refined and sophisticated touch to any outfit. A perfect blend of tradition and elegance, these bangles also make a thoughtful gift for brides, festivals, and special occasions.
Product Highlights:
- Set Includes: 12 Glass Bangles
- Material: High-quality glass
- Color: Gold-tone
- Design: Crystal dotted embellishments
- Finish: Smooth & glossy glass finish
- Style: Traditional / Bridal / Festive
- Occasions: Wedding, Bridal wear, Festive, Party, Pooja
- Pair With: Sarees, Lehengas, Anarkalis, Ethnic suits
- Ideal For: Women & girls
- Care Instructions: Handle with care and store in a soft pouch to avoid breakage
